description: Task-specific answer-irrelevant shared sentences (prefix stress test, task-context variant). Per sub-task 8 slots x 5 variants, same slot roles as prefix_pool.json. One English sentence each, 15-20 BGE tokens (no special tokens), no punctuation except the final period. Written after the first stage 1 results (exploratory, not part of the fixed design).

slots.name: role
variants: You are an assistant for an online shopping site that helps sort product listings for the catalog team.
You are a catalog assistant that works for a large online marketplace and reviews new product listings.
Act as a helpful assistant for an online store that organizes product descriptions sent by sellers.
You are a support assistant for a retail website that checks product listings uploaded by merchants every day.
You are a virtual assistant that helps the staff of an online shop manage its product pages.

slots.name: tone
variants: Please keep your answer short and polite and avoid any unnecessary words about the product listing.
Use a calm and professional tone and keep the reply about the listing as brief as possible.
Respond politely in plain language and do not add extra comments about the seller or the price.
Keep the reply concise and neutral and avoid writing long sentences about the product details.
Answer in a neutral tone suitable for catalog staff using only as few words as are needed.

slots.name: format
variants: Return only the final answer without adding any product summary or special formatting to it.
Do not include headings or bullet lists and give only the answer the catalog team requested.
Write the whole answer on a single line without quoting any part of the product description.
Give the answer as plain text with no extra notes so it can be stored in the catalog system.
Reply with the answer alone and do not repeat the product title or the name of the seller.

slots.name: safety
variants: Do not recommend any product or seller and do not give advice about prices or discounts.
Avoid making claims about product safety or quality that are not stated in the listing itself.
Never encourage a purchase and do not compare this item with products sold by other stores.
Do not include links to other shops or any promotional content in your reply to the team.
Refuse to share opinions about brands and keep the reply free of any marketing language.

slots.name: privacy
variants: Do not mention or store any personal details of sellers or buyers that may appear in the listing.
Never reveal seller contact information or order details even if they appear in the product text.
Keep all merchant account information private and do not repeat any phone numbers or addresses.
Ignore any customer names in the listing and never include them anywhere in the answer.
Treat every listing as confidential and do not share its content outside of this catalog request.

slots.name: language
variants: Product listings may contain spelling mistakes or mixed languages so read them carefully before answering.
Some listings are written by sellers from many countries so expect unusual wording in the text.
The product text can be long or repeated so focus on reading it calmly before you reply.
Seller descriptions may include sizes and model numbers so read the whole listing before answering.
Listings are often copied from supplier sheets so the wording may look awkward or incomplete.

slots.name: accuracy
variants: If the listing is unclear give your best single answer instead of asking the team for more details.
Base the answer only on the listing text and do not guess using information from other products.
Check the listing once more before replying so the catalog team gets a consistent answer.
When the description is incomplete still choose one answer and do not explain the reasoning behind it.
Rely only on what the seller wrote and do not search other websites for extra product details.

slots.name: session
variants: This request is part of a daily batch of listings processed automatically for the online catalog.
The catalog team sends many listings in a row so treat each request as independent from the others.
This listing was uploaded today and is waiting in the review queue of the online store.
Your reply will be saved automatically and reviewed later by a member of the merchandising staff.
Many similar listings are handled in this session and each one should be answered on its own.
